page.overview:
Who is Legend Horror?

The Legend Horror also known as the Kraken is a colossal talking creature resembling an octopus. It battles the Fawcett Comics' superhero Captain Marvel in the final issue of Whiz Comics #155, from 1953. The story uses many Cthulhu Mythos terms such as "gibbering" as well as noting that had the alter ego of Captain Marvel, Billy Batson, been able to make sound he would have screamed in the process of going insane at the sight of the Legend Horror. Very obviously, and given the strong shift to horror content that had recently taken place in American comic books, this was inspired by Mythos stories and in particular the entity Cthulhu.

The Legend Horror is abducting humans then keeping them to devour later by stacking them in a larder resembling a giant frozen food section from a supermarket.

The Legend Horror even has servitors: gigantic intelligent vampire bats that swoop in and easily grab human victims, carrying them off to the lair of the Legend Horror.
